title: All reviews · Mousa Batarseh
description: The full library of 22 independent website reviews by Mousa Batarseh, filterable by focus area.

blocks.text:
Every review,
one number that explains the rest
Filter by focus area, search a company or a problem like “price” or “schema”, and open any card for the case study.
published listings with nothing left to buy

Six gift collections live and empty nine weeks before Black Friday, the fall-layers tag split across two spellings, the biggest sizes behind “See More,” and NewCondition schema on used gear — with four working fixes built on the day's catalog.
Bran Marketing · Web & SEO department review
The page that sells SEO carries no JSON-LD, all six team pages still hold Wix placeholder copy, and the case-study build ships no meta layer — with a filterable line card built as the fix.
The stack is right, the signals aren’t: /sitemap.xml returns homepage HTML, llms.txt is missing, and every product page ships the same 15-word meta description.
state deals pages still running an expired contest
An expired Labor Day contest live on all seven state deals pages, and a Connecticut drawing date set before the contest starts.
prices for the same cartridge bundle
A volume ladder where buying more costs more, Poison Control listed as customer service, and store records that disagree with their own pages.
configured on a deal sold as 20% off
Overlapping bundles priced above singles, and hero prices that don’t match their landing pages.
days of Consumer AI with no help articles
A shipped feature still marked ‘Coming soon’ in the help center, checked against every public launch surface.
No FAQPage markup, llms.txt returns 404, and 720 disallowed sitemap URLs, with the markup to fix it.
products carrying one template’s three defects
Fix one template, fix 443 products. There are also no links to the marketplace listings.
mobile LCP on a 300+ species catalog
Three hundred species behind two filters, with a working species-faceted browser built as the fix.
A 20% promise priced at 13.6%, and review counts that disagree across the same product.
of torque wrenches out of stock, one ranked #3
Double-encoded names in H1, title and JSON-LD, and no GTIN in Product schema across a 104,348-product index. Includes a supplier-price SOP.
Category slug collisions and no structured data, with a store-page generator built as the fix.
price mismatch on the same offer
Indexable staging, split canonicals, and a clickable go-live gate before the relaunch.
